Description

An electronic management system supervises and governs all engine parameters. It optimises performance and fuel consumption by responding in real time to different service conditions.

The system is managed by a single control unit which controls both the methane ignition and injection.

The system uses signals received from numerous sensors to control actuators. It is connected to the following systems:

  • methane supply;
  • air supply system;
  • engine cooling;
  • exhaust with catalytic converter;

The system is also controlled by means of two relays located in the fuse and relay box in the engine compartment near the actual control unit. The supply lines for the control unit and the various system components (sensors and actuators) are protected by a special maxifuse and three other fuses also located in the above mentioned box.
